_about: Painted roughs for Studio HQ #33 (made free by the Art roughs workflow). ROUGH, mood only, not shipped. © 2026 justaskjoe. All rights reserved.
style: Game background illustration of a small village of studio buildings at dusk, in the illustrated style named in the subject. Crisp, clean, high detail, sharp edges, readable shapes, warm window light against a cool sky. Original design, not resembling any existing game or franchise. No text, no letters, no signs.

items.subject: In ink storybook style: crisp ink linework over soft watercolor washes on cream paper, cozy dusk. The whole village from above at a three-quarter angle, landscape: a big town hall with a clock tower at top center, a forge with a chimney and glowing anvil at top left, a cottage with an easel and big north windows at top right, a round town square with an empty notice board in the center, a long workshop with big open doors showing workbenches at bottom left, a small formal columned office, a supply shed with crates, and an arcade with glowing cabinet windows at bottom right, all linked by paths, each building clearly separate.

In ink storybook style: crisp ink linework over soft watercolor washes on cream paper, cozy dusk. Inside a long workshop room, wide landscape view: one row of six identical wooden workbenches across the room, each with an empty blank name plate on its front and a small desk lamp, tall back windows showing a dusk sky, wooden beams, the lower third of the picture calm and dark with nothing in it.
